# SoftmaxFreeSpikingLM

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking language model architecture that replaces the softmax operation with a biologically plausible, energy-efficient alternative for token probability estimation. Reduces computational and energy overhead in neuromorphic language processing, making it feasible to deploy language models on in-network neuromorphic hardware.
